info.description: Transliterate Spanish text to Andaluh EPA and optionally return Andaluh verb conjugations. Further info: https://github.com/andalugeeks/andaluh-py
info.title: Andaluh API

tags.name: transliteration
tags.description: Spanish text to transliterate to andaluz proposals

get.summary: Transliterates spanish text to andaluh EPA

parameters.name: spanish
parameters.default: Toda comunidad lingüística tiene derecho a codificar, estandarizar, preservar, desarrollar y promover su sistema lingüístico, sin interferencias inducidas o forzadas." Art. 9 de la Declaración Universal de los Derechos Lingüísticos

parameters.name: vaf
parameters.description: Voiceless alveolar fricative /s/: Use it to enforce seseo (assign "s"), zezeo (assign "z") or heheo (assign "h") instead of cedilla.

parameters.name: vvf
parameters.description: Voiceless velar fricative /x/: Use it to keep /x/ sounds as J instead of /h/ by assigning "j"

parameters.name: escapeLinks
parameters.description: Ignore URLs, mentions and hashtags on the transliteration

parameters.name: conjugate
parameters.description: Return Andaluh verb conjugation data using andaluh-verbs when true.

conjugation.description: Optional conjugation payload returned when the conjugate query parameter is true.

conjugation_error.description: Optional error string returned if conjugation was requested but could not be generated.
